description: Traces a superformula curve and puts out its two coordinates, which makes it a two dimensional LFO at low settings and an oscillator at high ones

params.text: Sets the rate the curve is traced at, -8 to 8 as a power of two, from about 0.004Hz to 261Hz; at the very bottom the rate is zero and the curve holds in place
Sets how wide the curve is drawn, 0 to 4
Sets how tall the curve is drawn, 0 to 4
Turns the whole curve about its centre, 0 to a full turn
Sets the first symmetry number of the formula, 0 to 16 in whole steps, which is how many lobes the curve has one way
Sets the second symmetry number, 0 to 16 in whole steps, which is how many lobes it has the other way
Sets the first exponent of the formula, 0.05 to 5, which is the strongest control over the shape
Turns the first exponent negative, which turns the curve inside out
Sets the second exponent of the formula, -5 to 5
Sets the third exponent of the formula, -5 to 5
Sets the first divisor of the formula, 0.05 to 5
Sets the second divisor of the formula, 0.05 to 5
Attenuates the voltage at the Scale-X jack before it is added to its knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Scale-Y jack before it is added to its knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Rotation jack before it is added to its knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the N1 jack before it is added to its knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the N2 jack before it is added to its knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the N3 jack before it is added to its knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the A jack before it is added to its knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the B jack before it is added to its knob, 0 to 100 per cent

inputs.text: Sets the rate by cable, 1V per octave added to the knob, one channel per voice
Drives the curve from an outside phase, 0-10V across one turn, added to the module's own phase; with the Freq knob at the bottom this makes it a phase driven oscillator
A trigger here puts the phase back to the start of the curve
Modulates the width, one per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates the height, one per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates that turning, one radian per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates that exponent, one per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates that exponent, one per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates that exponent, one per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates that divisor, one per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates that divisor, one per volt scaled by the knob beside it

outputs.text: The distance across of the point tracing the curve, held between -10V and 10V
The distance up of the point tracing the curve, held between -10V and 10V

notes: place the Plotter module immediately to the right and it draws the curve the settings are making
some settings of M0 and M1 give a curve that runs off to infinity, which is heard as a spike; the maker's advice is to start with M0 and M1 equal and to keep away from sharp, pointed curves
the speed of the point around the curve varies with its shape, so a pointed curve gives a much brighter sound than a round one at the same rate
